title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England files for review and approval a Firm Transportation Agreements with Edith Nourse Rogers Memorial Veterans Hospital.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department Approves the proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore Grants the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Paul B. Vasington, Chairman; Commissioner W. Robert Keating, James Connelly, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. (GC 02-28)
